books.title: Fortress of the Muslim (Hisnul Muslim)
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani
books.notes: A comprehensive collection of authentic supplications and remembrances from the Quran and Sunnah, covering all aspects of a Muslim's daily life. One of the most widely read Islamic books worldwide.

books.title: The Sealed Nectar (Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum)
books.author: Sheikh Safi-ur-Rahman Al-Mubarakpuri
books.notes: Award-winning biography of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Winner of first prize in the worldwide Seerah competition held by the Muslim World League in Makkah, 1979.

books.title: Riyad Us Saliheen (Gardens of the Righteous)
books.author: Imam Yahya ibn Sharaf Al-Nawawi
books.notes: One of the most celebrated Hadith collections, compiled by the renowned 13th-century scholar Imam Al-Nawawi. Contains ~1900 hadiths focused on ethics, character, and spiritual refinement.

books.title: Hisnul Muslim Urdu — Zubair Ali Edition
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani (Tahqeeq: Zubair Ali Zai)
books.notes: Scholarly Urdu edition of Hisnul Muslim with Hadith verification (Tahqeeq) and referencing (Takhreej) by renowned Hadith scholar Sheikh Zubair Ali Zai. Widely used in the Indian subcontinent.

books.title: Hisnul Muslim Urdu — Standard Text Edition
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani
books.notes: Standard Urdu text edition of the Fortress of the Muslim, presented in clear Urdu for millions of Urdu-speaking Muslims across Pakistan, India, and the global diaspora.

books.title: Alberuni's India
books.author: Al-Biruni (translated by Edward C. Sachau)
books.notes: A study of the religion, philosophy, sciences and customs of India by the Muslim scholar Al-Biruni, written around 1030. Often praised as an early and fair-minded work of comparative religion.

books.title: Hidayat al-Hayara (Guidance for the Perplexed)
books.author: Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya
books.notes: A classical scholarly reply to Jewish and Christian objections, discussing their beliefs and presenting the case for the prophethood of Muhammad (peace be upon him).

books.title: Jesus: Prophet of Islam
books.author: Muhammad Ata ur-Rahim
books.notes: Presents the Islamic view of Jesus as a prophet and messenger of God, and compares it with Christian beliefs about him.

books.title: Al-Farooq: The Life of Umar
books.author: Shibli Nomani
books.notes: A detailed biography of Umar ibn al-Khattab, the second caliph of Islam, covering his life, character and the administration of his caliphate. A classic work by one of the best-known Islamic historians of the subcontinent.

books.title: Introduction to Islam
books.author: Muhammad Hamidullah
books.notes: A compact and well-regarded overview of Islamic beliefs, worship, history and institutions, written by the renowned scholar Muhammad Hamidullah.
